homePage.title: Hi, my name is Zoe Wang.
homePage.subTitle: A passionate <1><2> Front End Developer</2> </1> based in Tachung, Taiwan.

aboutPage.text:
Frontend Engineer with nearly two years of experience developing B2B SaaS platforms, specializing in the React ecosystem (TypeScript) and Next.js frontend architecture. Proficient in managing complex data streams via WebSocket/SSE, and integrating Node.js with Supabase to implement Row Level Security (RLS) boundaries on the backend. Dedicated to ensuring high system quality and scalability by incorporating Vitest/Playwright automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and rigorous AI-assisted development workflows into daily delivery.

A strong advocate for team collaboration, actively engaging in code reviews, technical sharing, and documentation to continuously elevate system design and software engineering standards. Eager to join a tech- or product-driven team to leverage my expertise and drive impactful value.

projectsPage.project1Text: A website to track travel costs and itineraries from November 2021 to March 2022 in the United States and Canada.
projectsPage.project2Text: A website for managing multiple 3D printers that lets you plan production schedules based on real-time machine status, monitor daily printer conditions, and log printer maintenance records.
projectsPage.project3Text: A responsive ecommerce App UI using React JS and TailsindCSS with Using Fake Store API to Get Products Data
projectsPage.project4Text: A personal journaling app powered by generative AI. Built with React 18 and Node.js, it uses a proxy server to integrate Gemini and Pollinations.ai for mood analysis and illustration generation.
projectsPage.project5Text: A registration-free booking system for small barbershops: featuring real-time customer reservations on the frontend and autonomous stylist management on the backend, achieving zero developer maintenance.
